name: accessreview
author: Taako
description: Periodic access certification campaigns for sensitive Discord roles with member snapshots, reviewer attestations, separation of decisions from enforcement, completion tracking, and CSV evidence exports.
install_msg: AccessReview loaded. Start a campaign with `[p]accessreview create <name> <role>`.
short: Review and certify sensitive role access with safe, auditable campaigns.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores access-review campaign names, role IDs, snapshotted member Discord user IDs, reviewer Discord user IDs, keep/remove decisions, review notes, timestamps, enforcement results, and campaign actor IDs. CSV evidence is generated on demand.
